scope: Entire Playlists section and all20 M6 result fragments.88 new exact-fragment semantic/partial-proof reviews plus the existing PLID01 duplicate obligation.

groups.outcome: Accessible music playlists and tracks remain on Jellyfin and readable by other clients;excluded features stay outside scope.
mandatoryVariants: Server persistence visible to another read/client
groups.judgment: Current list uses account-scoped recursive playlist reads and filters non-audio media. Explicit create/rename write to Jellyfin;no local-only shadow playlist or delete/share/smart editor is exposed. Pending and uncertain behavior additionally belongs to PL02/PL07.
remaining: Dated live persistence is one configured server/runtime,not a complete server-version matrix or uncoached usability result.

groups.trigger: Submit a playlist name or cancel
groups.outcome: Readable guarded name dialog preserves failed draft and restores owned focus;confirmed creation opens detail only while still owned.
mandatoryVariants: Definite rejection permits explicit retry after readback
Uncertain Save stays locked with check action
groups.judgment: Name-dialog inFlight ref blocks repeated submission before React settles. Pending/readback is one mutation;input becomes readOnly and close is guarded. Focus ownership tracks dialog,window,visibility,outside focus and overlays. Current dialog restoration checks surviving opener then page heading.
remaining: Create-focus record explicitly leaves overlay/hidden-window cancellation at source-only review. Native phases and later Shared changes retain their exact limits;Q09 remains open.

groups.outcome: Choose existing/new destination and keep the guarded form until confirmed save/readback.
groups.judgment: Add dialog starts with a new destination and skip enabled. Ref-based guards retain read-only/pointer/key-locked values through asynchronous invalidation. Selected songs arrive in row order. Canonical duplicate behavior is retained as existing PLID01,not counted again.
remaining: The dedicated pending-form native run uses one song;bulk/album native/live proof retains its older version and scope. No new native or live add is claimed here.

groups.trigger: Play/select repeated songs or fetch unsafe occurrence IDs
groups.outcome: Preserve independent occurrences;disable only unsafe Move/Remove and avoid guessing a replacement playlist.
mandatoryVariants: Repeated songs with distinct entry IDs
Safe uniquely identified entries remain editable
Changed entries clear unreliable selections and preserve unique ones
groups.judgment: Identity counting disables duplicate canonical handles. Renderer generates unique fallback keys for unsafe rows without making them editable. Service rechecks live entries and validates move index before reservation. Selection refresh preserves only keys that still identify one editable occurrence.
remaining: No conditional server transaction prevents another client changing entries between preflight and write. Actual live ambiguous-handle server support is not established by controlled malformed responses.

groups.outcome: Modify the intended entry and hand owned focus to a surviving action without disguising uncertainty.
groups.judgment: Removal captures the reviewed key order and originating menu trigger. Focus resolution checks surviving rows,then Back;uncertainty selects visible recovery rather than reporting success. Main serializes by account/playlist and uses occurrence endpoint APIs.
remaining: Recovery-focus record names source phases and missing same-song duplicate-row/pending-marker/window variants. This review does not turn those into current native passes.

groups.trigger: Read permissions or attempt a server-authorized edit
groups.outcome: Explicit read-only disables editing;unknown permission remains distinct and does not hide readable tracks.
mandatoryVariants: Denied edit visible without automatic retry
groups.judgment: Current service recognizes only actual booleans as permission evidence. Selected optional lookup failures return unknown;401/current-account changes escape as their own errors. UI locks confirmed read-only and otherwise lets the server authorize after a successful permission read,with separate read failures shown.
remaining: P05 still requires actual unavailable-permission live configuration. Controlled optional lookup failure does not replace it. No new real account/access change here.

groups.trigger: Write confirmation is lost,invalid,partial or interrupted
groups.outcome: Persist intent before uncertain edits;require a fresh reviewed read and acknowledgement without replay.
mandatoryVariants: No remainder/read failure leaves no intent
Read begun pending cannot authorize acknowledgement
Unavailable recovery storage rejects before dispatch
groups.judgment: Recovery saves markers before dispatch,retains ambiguous outcomes and removes markers only after confirmed success/definite rejection. Read receipts carry marker/epoch/pending identity;pending or changed reads cannot issue a valid acknowledgement. Status-only mutations do not await unused body;creation consumes/validates returned ID. The current identity fix preserves preflight-before-reserve and one marker across batches.
remaining: Controlled file failures and ordinary restarts do not prove power-loss durability. Live lost confirmation is a controlled client fault after a real successful write,not an actual server outage.

groups.trigger: Navigate,change libraries/account or reopen after an unresolved edit
groups.outcome: Keep affected recovery discoverable and scoped while other music/playlists remain usable.
mandatoryVariants: Affected Add destination disabled with explanation/direct Review
Unresolved creation leaves existing destinations usable
Rename and Add respect known locks
Late old account cannot refresh new data
groups.judgment: SessionContent retains recovery across same-ID ready-screen changes and remounts for another account. Recovery keys hash server/account/playlist. Main epoch guards returned read/receipt state;unmounted old-account recovery callbacks are ignored. Affected destinations remain locked while unrelated music and playlists stay available.
remaining: Prior boundary checks retain their controlled accounts/restart scopes. No new native account-change/library-save sequence is claimed;auth-expiry evidence covers its separately named race,not all playlist mutations.

groups.trigger: Refresh or acknowledge a recovery state
groups.outcome: Retain the focused pending action and acknowledge only the exact reviewed version.
mandatoryVariants: Failure retains action only for same reviewed version
Success targets list result or detail Back only while owned
Older action never clears newer marker
groups.judgment: Immediate action refs and account/playlist mutation keys prevent overlap across component remounts. UI rechecks captured marker/receipt against cache;main independently checks current account epoch,active writer,marker and receipt before clearing. Focus uses the shared ownership guard.
remaining: Named native focus record is phase-scoped with residual variants. Source validation of receipts is not a substitute for VoiceOver or observed understanding of acknowledgement.

STARContext.story: I can edit playlists without repeating uncertain changes
STARContext.situationAndTask: My account may edit a shared playlist, or a save loses its response
STARContext.action: Attempt the allowed action; inspect refreshed order after an uncertain result
STARContext.expectedResult: Recovery Refresh/confirmation retain focused controls, label their own pending action and block overlap across music navigation; confirmation applies only to the reviewed state and conditionally hands focus to list results or detail Back. Removing the focused occurrence hands focus to the next surviving reviewed occurrence, then previous, or Back; uncertainty stays explicit and later navigation cancels that handoff. Adding songs keeps destination, name and skip-existing values readable and focusable through save/readback, locks changes and visibly guards Save/Cancel/Close/Review against duplicate writes or navigation, retains definite-failure drafts for explicit retry, and closes on success with opener focus; Creating or renaming keeps the name readable and focus within the pending dialog; repeated save/dismiss keys cannot repeat the change; confirmed creation opens its detail on Back while the modal still owns interaction, including internal Tab movement; outside actions, overlays or backgrounding cancel that focus handoff; definite rejection retains the editable draft after readback, uncertain saves stay locked, and rename/cancel restore their opener; Jellyfin authorizes unknown permissions, explicit read-only stays disabled, unconfirmed permission never claims read-only or hides otherwise readable tracks, auth/account or playlist-data failures still surface, errors remain visible, and an uncertain reorder/removal needs successful refresh plus acknowledgement before editing continues; pending/error/review state survives page changes, playlist switches, library saves and same-account sign-in; after restart an unresolved addition/reorder/removal still needs a fresh detail read and explicit acknowledgement, without replay; an uncertain creation requires checking the refreshed playlist list before another create; affected playlist tiles say Review needed and their Add destinations are disabled, with an explanation and direct Review playlists action in the Add dialog; failed duplicate reads and empty additions leave no false lock; other playlists/accounts remain usable and returning to the original account retains its unresolved change; repeated positions select and play independently; if the server cannot identify an occurrence separately, explain unavailable Move/Remove actions while retaining listening and safe edits; changing entries clears unreliable selections and preserves uniquely identified ones
